description: Infrastructure overview using the USE method: utilization, saturation and errors for each host, plus cluster health.

panels.description: CloudNativePG authentik cluster. Down when its exporter is down, otherwise health from data volume and inode usage.

targets.expr: (max((max(max by(persistentvolumeclaim) (1 - kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{namespace="authentik", persistentvolumeclaim=~"authentik-1"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace="authentik", persistentvolumeclaim=~"authentik-1"}))) OR (max by(persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_inodes_used{namespace="authentik", persistentvolumeclaim=~"authentik-1"} / kubelet_volume_stats_inodes{namespace="authentik", persistentvolumeclaim=~"authentik-1"})))) and on() (max(cnpg_collector_up{cluster="authentik"}) == 1) or on() vector(-1)

panels.description: HostDZire6tb serves the arr stack's media over NFS. Down: node-exporter unreachable over Tailscale. Read-only: / or /srv is read-only or failing. NFS down: nfsd has no threads. Otherwise health from the fuller of / and /srv.

targets.expr: (max(1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter",node="hostdzire",mountpoint=~"/|/srv"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",node="hostdzire",mountpoint=~"/|/srv"}) and on() (max(node_filesystem_readonly{job="node-exporter",node="hostdzire",mountpoint=~"/|/srv"} + node_filesystem_device_error{job="node-exporter",node="hostdzire",mountpoint=~"/|/srv"}) == 0) and on() (max(node_nfsd_server_threads{job="node-exporter",node="hostdzire"}) > 0)) or on() (vector(-3) and on() (max(node_filesystem_readonly{job="node-exporter",node="hostdzire",mountpoint=~"/|/srv"} + node_filesystem_device_error{job="node-exporter",node="hostdzire",mountpoint=~"/|/srv"}) == 0)) or on() (vector(-2) and on() (max(up{job="node-exporter",node="hostdzire"}) == 1)) or on() vector(-1)
